static_traits.name: Chen Siming
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk with, but not yet discussing health worries and negative thoughts with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; not yet received psychotherapy before; not yet had similar problem experiences
static_traits.language_features: Clear but pessimistic expression, often using catastrophic and self-blaming statements; acceptable cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I believe my health has been ruined by high caffeine intake and unhealthy diet, and I will never recover my previous health level. This belief brings a sense of despair and hopelessness; recently experiencing physical symptoms like fatigue, headaches, digestive problems, which persist even after trying to reduce caffeine and improve diet.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize negative thoughts and health worries are affecting my daily functioning and quality of life.

core_beliefs: My health is already ruined by me
I will never recover to my past health level
My health problems It is all my fault

special_situations.event: Experiencing fatigue, headaches, digestive discomfort after consuming caffeine or junk food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep consuming unhealthy food or caffeine, it will cause permanent damage to health
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to reduce caffeine intake and improve diet
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have already ruined my health, can never recover

special_situations.event: Even with reduced caffeine and improved diet, physical symptoms still persist
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no marked improvement shortly after changing, it shows the damage is irreversible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Believing continued effort is meaningless, developing thoughts of giving up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is utterly Meaningless, my health has irreversibly worsened

special_situations.event: When school and personal life Increased stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Under great stress, can only rely on caffeine and junk food to cope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In stress situations, increases caffeine and junk food intake to self-soothe
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot control it, this is the only way

special_situations.event: When thinking of talking to friends about one's health worries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I confide in friends, they will not understand or care about me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding sharing with friends, staying Withdrawn
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand or care about me

core_conflict.wish: Yearns to recover health and be understood and supported
core_conflict.fear: Fearing health problems are irreversible, being not understood or ignored by others
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated through self-criticism and avoiding sharing
Maintaining some control to reduce Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A defective, damaged self (the guilty one who bears full responsibility for health problems)
object_relations.object_representation: Indifferent or ununderstanding others (who may not care about my worries)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to share health worries with friends and seek social support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing friends will not understand or care about her (transference: Projecting the expectation of being ignored onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using vague and reserved expressions, avoiding committing to share, cautious tone, reducing detail disclosure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: After working to reduce caffeine and improve diet, symptoms still exist in the short term
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting real-life fluctuations as 'total failure', believing damage irreversible
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using absolute words (e.g. 'forever' 'completely' 'totally'), refusing to see gradual improvement, firm negating tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When school or personal life Increased stress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing she has no control over behavior, can only rely on caffeine and junk food
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Ending exploration of alternatives on grounds of 'no way' 'this is the only way', helpless tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: After physical discomfort (fatigue, headaches, digestive problems)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning Anxiety and dissatisfaction toward the self, believing everything is her own fault
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reinforcing self-reproach statements like 'It is all my fault', low tone, avoiding pointing to external factors.

manifestations: Repeatedly deeming diet and routine improvements 'utterly Meaningless'
Feeling hopeless, concluding health is irreversible
outcomes: Reduced motivation, reducing sustained change efforts

manifestations: Unwilling to share health worries with friends, believing they will not understand or care
Believing under pressure 'I cannot control it, this is the only way', relying on caffeine and junk food

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-reproach, believing health problems 'It is all my fault'
Emphasizing in counseling she should do better but feeling helpless

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presupposing friends 'do not understand or do not care about' her worries
Thus avoiding direct contact and sharing with others

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Deflecting topics with 'very awkward' 'they won't understand' when facing sharing suggestions
Avoids detailed discussion of specific support methods

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turns frustration and anger into self-blame and inner friction
Not seeking support but choosing to bear it alone

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling, motivated to change
Having tried reducing caffeine intake and improving diet
Able to identify and describe negative thinking patterns (e.g. catastrophizing)
Has some social support potential (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Habitual coping of relying on caffeine and junk food under stress
Social avoidance, difficulty seeking support from others
Excessive worry about health and negative future predictions

target_behavior.behavior: Consuming high caffeine and junk food under stress
antecedent: When fatigue, headaches, digestive discomfort appear
target_behavior.core_reason: Using caffeine and junk food as instant soothing for stress and discomfort
target_behavior.function: Quickly relieving tension and discomfort, gaining short-term mental uplift or emotional soothing
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening physical symptoms, reinforcing health worries and negative thinking

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic negative self-talk (such as 'I have ruined my health')
antecedent: After consuming caffeine or junk food
Trying to change but seeing no improvement in the short term
target_behavior.core_reason: Core belief in irreversible health damage and overgeneralized cognitive patterns
target_behavior.function: Finding certain Interpretation for Anxiety, venting Guilt and self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Increased hopelessness, Learning/Decline in work performance, further impaired sleep and self-care

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal and avoiding sharing distress
antecedent: When thinking about discussing health concerns with friends
When advised to seek social support
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing others will not understand or care about her
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being negated or embarrassed, maintaining surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: Support system not yet activated, Loneliness and pressure maintained or even worsened
